text:
sarah_sales: Heads up — FinanceCorp just submitted their security questionnaire and a CAIQ export. Deadline EOW Friday. Attaching files shortly. We need a security owner, answers, and confirmation on SSO/SAML. Anyone can pick this up?

raj_se: looping in @mike_security and @alex_solutions. Quick Q: do they want architecture diagrams or just the CAIQ/answers?

mike_security: I can own the controls mapping (CAIQ). I'll tag what requires evidence and what needs ops input. Need VPC/network diagram and SOC2. @jen_infra can you share the VPC diagram and any network segmentation notes?

jen_infra: on it — uploading vpc_diagram_v1.pdf now. Also, do they require public IP egress details? If yes, I need to pull the NAT table.

sarah_sales: uploaded SOC2_2025.pdf to the thread and shared the customer's CAIQ export. Sales has an ask: confirm data residency options (US/EU) and SAML config. :eyes: 

alex_solutions: I'll handle the SSO/SCIM answers and coordinate a short demo for their security team. Note: SCIM is beta for Dedicated customers, we should state that clearly.

mike_security: plan — map CAIQ -> our controls, mark "Provided evidence" when we can attach SOC2/Pentest reports, mark "Assessed" where documented, and "Requires design" where we need infra input. Expect to finish initial mapping by Wednesday. Flag any high-risk items for leadership.

raj_se: do we have any standing exceptions or prior agreements with FinanceCorp around EU hosting? Sales, confirm contract note.

sarah_sales: they indicated EU hosting acceptable with addendum. I'll draft the contract clause and share link.

mike_security: snippet of mapping I'm going to use:
```
CAIQ Q1.2 -> Control: Access Control (IAM)
Answer: Role-based access, SSO (SAML/OIDC) enforced
Evidence: SOC2_2025.pdf, SSO_metadata.png
Notes: If customer needs SCIM, we can enable beta on Dedicated with an MSA addendum.
```

jen_infra: uploaded vpc_diagram_v1.pdf :paperclip: 

vault_bot: SOC2_2025.pdf uploaded to secure vault by sarah_sales — access granted to users in #security and #solutions.

mike_security: tagging @security_ops to pull our latest pen-test summary and vuln scan artifacts. Need those to complete evidence links. Target to submit completed questionnaire by Thu EOD. :thumbsup: 

security_ops: acknowledged — will attach pen_test_summary_2024.pdf by tomorrow morning.

sarah_sales: thanks team — I'll update FinanceCorp with our expected timeline (Thu EOD) and set up the demo for next Tue. Keep me posted on blockers.

mike_security: will surface any blockers. If we hit >10 high-risk findings we'll pause demo and sync with legal.
